headline: Record sales and margin, helped by tariff refunds
summary_short: Net sales rose 17.2% y/y to CHF 931.4M and net income rose 36.9% to CHF 162.8M. Gross margin of 72.6% includes CHF 52.6M of U.S. tariff refunds.
summary_long: Every channel and region grew; DTC rose 25.0% and APAC 31.1%. Gross margin was 66.9% excluding tariff refunds. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 27.6%, or 21.9% excluding the refunds. Cash reached CHF 1,339.0M. Full-year net sales growth is still guided to the low-20% range at constant currency; gross margin guidance is about 67.5% including refunds, or about 66% excluding them.
confidence_notes: Figures are in CHF (IFRS); the shard's EPS row is labelled USD but matches the CHF adjusted EPS of 0.54 in the release. Margins and adjusted EBITDA are inflated by CHF 52.6M of one-time U.S. tariff refunds. Prior-year comparison also benefited from one-time freight savings. Guidance not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: Growth came from every channel, region and category; DTC and apparel grew fastest, with each region posting its highest quarterly sales to date.
CHF 52.6M of U.S. tariff refunds lifted the margin; excluding them it was 66.9%. The company also cites full-price selling and a higher own-channel share.
Margin was 27.6%, or 21.9% excluding the tariff refunds, up from 22.6% a year earlier.
Management attributes results to its premium playbook: products sold at full price, athlete validation and premium retail experiences.
